description: Defines the interface and classes for HTTP/2 bidirectional streaming, including the BidirectionalStreamImpl class and its Delegate interface, used for managing bidirectional HTTP/2 streams.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamImpl
classes.description: Interface for HTTP/2 bidirectional streaming, managing stream lifecycle, data transfer, and error handling.

classes.name: BidirectionalStreamImpl::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for handling events and callbacks related to the bidirectional stream, such as readiness, headers reception, data transfer, trailers, and errors.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the bidirectional stream with request info, logging, delegate, timer, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers to the server, either automatically or manually.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer, returning bytes read or error code.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends data buffers over the stream, with optional end_stream flag.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Populates load timing info for connection establishment.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details if available.
